spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing, thumb-friendly touch targets (minimum 44x44px), mobile-first viewport container (max-w-md mx-auto on desktop for crisp mobile app feel)
spacing_and_layout.grid_worms_picker: grid grid-cols-4 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2.5 p-3 bg-slate-900/90 rounded-xl border border-slate-800

bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-slate-800 px-2 py-2 flex justify-around items-center max-w-md mx-auto

worms_rule_picker.concept: Gamla Worms vapenval - visuellt rutnät av regel-ikoner med tap-to-toggle och retro neonglöd
worms_rule_picker.style: aspect-square flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-lg border text-center transition-all cursor-pointer min-h-[54px]

elo_badge.positive: inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30
elo_badge.negative: inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30

shittalk_feed.description: Kommentarsfält med snabbval för emojis (🔥, 💩, 🤡, 👑, 🎯, 🚀, 😭) + textkommentarer med spelar-avatar
shittalk_feed.card_style: p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 text-sm space-y-1.5

auth_screen.features: E-post & Lösenord inloggning / registrering + Google login mockup knapp
auth_screen.style: min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-center px-6 py-12 bg-slate-950 text-slate-100

motion.tab_transition: animate with subtle fade and slide-up
motion.elo_counter: animated counting up/down when match is saved
motion.rule_toggle: spring physics scale effect on tap

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components MUST include a unique data-testid in kebab-case, e.g. data-testid='new-match-submit-button', data-testid='rule-toggle-kortbyte', data-testid='tab-leaderboard'
testing_and_accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px target area for mobile thumbs

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Swedish text throughout all screens without exception.
Implement full mock backend storage (localStorage / state) with pre-populated realistic Swedish players, match history, rules, and patch notes.
Ensure bottom navigation bar is sticky, thumb-friendly, and contains all 5 tabs: Ny match, Historik, Topplista, Regler, Patch-notes.
Worms rule picker grid in 'Ny match' flow must feature grid of rule icons with instant tap-to-toggle visuals, description tooltips/modals, and custom rule inline modal.
Elo calculation should dynamically adjust player ratings based on 3-6 player placements, displaying immediate '+18' / '-12' badges upon submitting.
Every card, button, tab, and form control MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent background on dropdowns or overlays.
Maintain contrast standards (minimum 4.5:1 for body text).
Do not center-align body text globally.
Keep mobile container max-w-md centered on desktop for realistic mobile app preview.
